I had finally fallen asleep, when I woke up and found the lights on, and my BF kneeling in front of a puddle of vomit on his carpet. I ask what's going on and he says like "sorry, do you think you can help me clean? Keep falling down" He was speaking weird like speaking was annoying him. I told him he couldn't make me clean after his own mess and he was cryptic and I think now he said something like he thought he was allowed to ask but he wasn't making demands. I tell him he should just ckean it up he says like "sorry can't clean". I leave the room to go for the couch and I just see him lie down on the carpet next to the puddle and I ask what he's doing.
